notes: wowsims-forever models one Hunter spell package for all three specs; this is the spec the fork's own p1.apl.json preset is already built for (heavy Aimed Shot weaving), so it is the closest adaptation of the three hunter files. Marksmanship also keeps Serpent Sting up for the extra sustained damage, unlike Beast Mastery where community guides call it not worth a global. Every rank named here is checked against this build's own spellconst: the preset names Multi-Shot as spell 25294, which does not exist in this build (Multi-Shot only has one rank here, 2643), and calls Serpent Sting rank 8 when 25295 is actually rank 9 -- both fixed here rather than copied stale. Aimed Shot (20904) is registered by the engine again since 2026-09-28 (its registration had been commented out, and the cast line was declared inert until then). What did need fixing: nothing in this site's request pipeline (sim/request) ever sets a character's DistanceFromTarget, so every hunter starts at 0 -- inside Raptor Strike's melee range but under Multi-Shot, Serpent Sting and Aimed Shot's own ExtraCastCondition floor of 12 (core.MinRangedAttackDistance), which also gates the ranged auto-attack itself (sim/core/attack.go's startPull). A `move` prepull action to 30 yards is added so this and every future simulation of this spec actually has a ranged auto-attack and can cast its ranged abilities, matching how a Marksmanship hunter is actually played. Under this smoke build specifically (no gear equipped anywhere) the ranged weapon's SwingSpeed is the Weapon{} zero value, which collapses the ranged swing timer to its 500ms cast-time floor (sim/core/attack.go's WeaponAttack.updateSwingDuration: curSwingDuration = weapon.SwingSpeed / hasteMultiplier = 0) -- a real ranged weapon's positive SwingSpeed does not have this problem. The resulting sub-GCD auto-shot loop saturates the character's action economy so completely that the priority list, including Multi-Shot and Serpent Sting, never gets a decision window in this one bare-weapon run; this is a new engine-side artifact of the no-gear smoke build (recorded for the engine ledger), not a defect in this rotation's gates. Rotation-accuracy program diagnosis (2026-09-28): the inert ids above (Multi-Shot 2643, Rapid Fire 3045) are level-gated in the engine (sim/hunter/multi_shot.go RequiredLevel 18, sim/hunter/rapid_fire.go's registerRapidFire returns if hunter.Level < 26) but carry rank:0 rows in spellranks.json, which the ladder's idLearnLevel deliberately does not level-gate (the same skip keeps Bloodrage/Judgement -- genuinely never level-gated by the engine -- from being wrongly treated as gated); not declared inert here (both resolve fine above their real gate under the pinned engine); see hunter-beast-mastery.json's notes (the shared hunter spell package all three specs use) for the full diagnosis and the sim/internal/spellranks + sim/request/ladder.go fix that actually resolves this. 2026-10-31 (theorycraft audit fixes): Multi-Shot and Aimed Shot share one 6 second cooldown in Forever (client spell category 2; both tooltips say so), and the engine now runs them on one timer. On that shared timer the instant Multi-Shot outdamages Aimed Shot, whose 2 second cast pauses the auto shot, so Multi-Shot fires on every cooldown and Aimed Shot is only the pre-pull opener. The lines that used to read Aimed Shot's cooldown now read Multi-Shot's, the same clock. Client 1.60.1.70707 (2026-10-31): Aspect of the Hawk's ranks 1-5 fell to 15/22/30/38/47 ranged attack power, so rank 6 (14322, 55) is the strongest from level 58 and the prepull casts it; through 70685 rank 5 (90) was, and rank 6 was skipped as inferior. 2026-11-03 (sim-accuracy round 13, server hotfix push for 1.60.1.70753): Aimed Shot about doubled at every rank, Arcane Shot, Serpent Sting, Aspect of the Hawk and Trueshot Aura went up. Aimed Shot now takes the shared cooldown whenever the next auto shot is more than 1.2 seconds away, and Multi-Shot only when the cast would hold an auto shot; measured beyond error at seeds 1 and 50001. Serpent Sting is back in the list (it was dropped by the 2026-10-08 rotation search): on this engine it gains beyond error at both seeds, before and after the push.

Warcraft Tavern: Classic Marksmanship Hunter rotation (Aimed Shot / Multi-Shot weave, Serpent Sting kept up)
Forever Sixty default rotation, unvalidated until the nightly job runs

priorityList.notes: Hunter's Mark whenever the target is not marked. One mark per target is enough: if another hunter's mark is already up, leave it.

Rapid Fire on the pull, as an auto shot leaves and Multi-Shot is about to come back. The haste starts on a fresh shot and the first Multi-Shot lands inside it. It is a five minute cooldown, so a boss fight gets one: put your trinkets and racial on the same press.

Aimed Shot when the shared cooldown comes up right after an auto shot fires. It outhits Multi-Shot whenever the cast fits. If you are partway to your next auto shot, take Multi-Shot instead and keep the auto rolling.
Multi-Shot on the shared cooldown when Aimed Shot's cast would hold an auto shot. It is instant, so it never delays your next shot.

Sniper Shot when the shared cooldown is down and an auto shot has just left. Its 4 second cast holds your next auto, so start it right after one fires, never partway to the next. It is your hardest hit, on its own 15 second cooldown.

Serpent Sting when it has under 1.5 seconds left and the shared cooldown is not about to come back. Refreshing any earlier throws away a tick. It is the best damage for its mana you have between the big shots, so keep it rolling for the whole fight.

Arcane Shot to fill a gap when the shared cooldown is more than a global away and you are above 25% mana. It is instant and never holds an auto shot, but it costs the most mana for its damage, so it is the shot you drop first when the mana runs low.
